_readme: How a filer's per-class share counts (dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding, one line per class in SEC XBRL) and its EPS become the listed ticker's units (api/_lib/secFundamentals.js). Classes with equal economics (GOOG/GOOGL, META, …) need nothing: they are summed. classes: [{ below, ratio }] multiplies a class line smaller than `below` by `ratio`; divideAll divides the summed count; epsDivisor divides the reported EPS. Always cite the source.

BRK-B.source: Berkshire Hathaway 10-K: each Class A share is convertible into 1,500 Class B shares; net earnings per share are stated per average equivalent Class A share.

BRK-A.source: Berkshire Hathaway 10-K: Class B = 1/1,500 of a Class A share; the count is stated in Class A equivalents.
